host.intent: ACTION_VIEW and validated same-app content URI; no URI opens prepared internal runtime information
host.duplicateIntent: Does not replace or launch a second native session

nativeOwnership.classloader: child-first only for org.libsdl.app, com.bachatas4.android.runtime, org.emulationstation.ps4child
nativeOwnership.SystemLoad: Absolute verified dependency paths, executed by the child-owned bootstrap; no parent native load
nativeOwnership.exit: NativeRuntimeBridge.stop() only after confirmed Sair/Back; private process exits after native run returns
nativeOwnership.surface: Same retained TextureView SurfaceTexture/Surface; detach does not invent pause/rebind JNI or request native stop
nativeOwnership.staticCallEvidence: JNI run uses ANativeWindow_fromSurface and BachataNativeMain; that path does not invoke SDL.nativeSetupJNI, SDL_Init or WindowSDL

preparation.validation: Confined paths, duplicate/unexpected/missing ZIP rejection, exact size and SHA256 per file, atomic staging promotion, read-only and non-executable files; full SHA256 before cache reuse
preparation.shaders: No standalone shader directory in upstream APK; native runtime contains compiled shader support and private MESA cache defaults
preparation.unusedDirectRouteComponents: GLIBC host loader, X server and Vortek routes are not loaded by this Bionic owner

packageImport.defaultPasscode: 32 zero characters, as upstream default import route
packageImport.rsaMaterial: Common public-upstream PKG import CRT material, explicitly authorized for private local installer only; never public source arrays
packageImport.automaticRegistration: Native probe plus URI/FD metadata fingerprint; worker imports once into atomic private staging, validates actual eboot.bin and sce_sys/param.sfo TITLE_ID, then reuses registered game
packageImport.titleIdValidation: ^[A-Z]{4}[0-9]{5}$ from real SFO metadata; not inferred from filename or demonstration marker
packageImport.invalidEncryptedOrIncompletePackages: Explicit preparation failure; no placeholder ready state or fabricated game

inputAndAudio.inputProtocol: BACHATA/1 INPUT, 12 mandatory fields, slot0..3, per-slot increasing sequence
inputAndAudio.inputTransport: Private filesystem AF_UNIX, same-UID peer verification, event-driven bounded/coalesced writes, neutral on focus loss or physical disconnect
inputAndAudio.physical: Android gamepad/joystick events for USB and Bluetooth, four assigned devices, native PS4 masks, axes/deadzones/triggers/hat
inputAndAudio.touch: Static PS4 pad with dual analog sticks; hidden for connected physical controllers; physical and touch axes are separate
inputAndAudio.audioProtocol: BACHATA_ALSA_SOCKET code4 prepare/code5 PCM/code0 close, five-byte little-endian request header
inputAndAudio.audio: Worker AudioTrack PCM conversion for upstream sample types and channels1/2/8, bounded writes, no UI polling
